quote: Looking back, I imagine I was always writing. Twaddle it was, too. But better far write twaddle or anything, anything, than nothing at all.
source: Katherine Mansfield, Journal of Katherine Mansfield, July 1922, Sierre; ed. J. Middleton Murry (Knopf, 1927), p. 246
note: The wording and the entry are as proposed. The page was corrected: in the 1927 Knopf edition the page numbers are printed at the foot, and the lines fall on page 246, not 245. They close the July 1922 Sierre entry, just before the editor’s note on her return to London.
